verdict.rationale: Vendor claims (208MB 3D V-Cache, boost/PBO tuning, EXPO memory OC) are corroborated by independent hands-on game benchmarks from TechPowerUp and Tom's Hardware showing top-tier gaming performance (37% faster than Intel flagship in 1080p gaming, near-parity with 9800X3D) plus real-world thermal/OC behavior notes. Missing for 10: no dedicated iGPU-class gaming benchmark discussion since this chip lacks integrated graphics relevance, and no broader multi-outlet aggregation beyond two review sites.
